This looks like a helical protein region, so I'm checking the CA coordinates around residues 43-49 to verify the backbone geometry consistent with an alpha helix.

Consecutive CA distances come out around 3.8 Å, matching typical helical spacing, and the i to i+3 distances land near 5.0 Å, also consistent with alpha-helical geometry.

Checking the i to i+4 distances too, they cluster around 6.3 Å, confirming this segment forms an alpha helix.
